SELECT order_id AS orderId, platform_type AS platformType, platform_order_id AS platformOrderId, status, ordered_at AS orderedAt, gross_order_amount AS grossOrderAmount, customer_paid_amount AS customerPaidAmount, provider_financial_data_status AS financialDataStatus
FROM report_orders
ORDER BY
gross_order_amount
status
ordered_at
ASC
DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT ri.menu_id AS menuId, ri.menu_name AS menuName,
COALESCE( SUM(ri.quantity), 0 ) AS soldQuantity,
COALESCE( SUM( ri.ordered_unit_price * ri.quantity ), 0 ) AS grossSales,
COALESCE( SUM( ri.menu_cost * ri.quantity ), 0 ) AS estimatedMenuCost,
COALESCE( SUM( ri.packaging_cost * ri.quantity ), 0 ) AS estimatedPackagingCost
FROM report_order_items ri
INNER JOIN report_orders ro ON ro.order_id = ri.order_id
WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId}
AND ro.status = 'DELIVERED'
AND ro.ordered_at >= #{from}
AND ro.ordered_at <= #{to}
AND ro.platform_type = #{platformType}
GROUP BY ri.menu_id, ri.menu_name
ORDER BY grossSales DESC, soldQuantity DESC, ri.menu_id ASC
